headline: Frontend Software Engineer
summary: Frontend engineer with experience building accessible web interfaces and reusable React components. Worked with designers and backend developers on product features.

bullets: Developed reusable React components for internal web applications.
Integrated REST APIs and fixed UI bugs reported during testing.
Worked with product designers to improve keyboard navigation on forms.
Maintained HTML, CSS, and JavaScript pages for client websites.
Reviewed code changes with colleagues and documented recurring issues.
